report_topic: Performance Audit on Storm Water Drainage and Sewerage Management Systems in Municipal Corporations
observations_summary: The audit found that municipal infrastructure for storm water drainage and sewerage systems has not kept pace with rapid urbanisation, leading to poor maintenance, waterlogging, urban flooding, and environmental pollution. Significant deficiencies in planning, project execution, and monitoring resulted in time and cost overruns, underutilization of funds, and discharge of untreated sewage into water bodies.
